hooks.command: git fetch --quiet 2>/dev/null; BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$BRANCH" ]; then BEHIND=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/$BRANCH 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$BEHIND" -gt 0 ]; then echo "Branch $BRANCH is $BEHIND commits behind origin."; fi; fi

if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then INPUT=$(cat); FILEPATH=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path | select(type == "string")' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILEPATH" ] && printf '%s\n' "$FILEPATH" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$'; then PROJECT_DIR="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; PRETTIER="$PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/prettier"; if [ -x "$PRETTIER" ] && node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"),p=require("node:path");try{const root=fs.realpathSync(process.argv[1]),file=fs.realpathSync(p.resolve(root,process.argv[2])),rel=p.relative(root,file);process.exit(rel&&rel!==".."&&!rel.startsWith(".."+p.sep)&&!p.isAbsolute(rel)&&fs.statSync(file).isFile()?0:1)}catch{process.exit(1)}' "$PROJECT_DIR" "$FILEPATH" 2>/dev/null; then (cd "$PROJECT_DIR" && "$PRETTIER" --write -- "$FILEPATH") 2>/dev/null || printf '[baseline] Local formatter failed; run project formatting checks.\n' >&2; fi; fi; fi

if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then INPUT=$(cat); FILEPATH=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILEPATH" ] && echo "$FILEPATH" | grep -qE '\.env\.example$'; then echo '.env.example modified. Reminder: update local .env if new vars added.'; fi; fi

if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then INPUT=$(cat); FILEPATH=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILEPATH" ] && echo "$FILEPATH" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$' && ! echo "$FILEPATH" | grep -qE '\.(test|spec)\.(ts|tsx)$'; then DIR=$(dirname "$FILEPATH"); BASE=$(basename "$FILEPATH" | sed 's/\.[^.]*$//'); TESTFILE="${DIR}/${BASE}.test.ts"; if [ ! -f "$TESTFILE" ]; then echo "No co-located test file found. Consider: $TESTFILE"; fi; fi; fi

INPUT=$(cat); if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf\s+/|DROP\s+(DATABASE|TABLE)|TRUNCATE\s+TABLE|format\s+c:|git\s+push\s+--force|git\s+reset\s+--hard|docker\s+system\s+prune'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Destructive command blocked by baseline hook"}}'; fi; else printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"jq not available - destructive command guard cannot validate. Install jq to proceed."}}'; fi
osascript -e 'display notification "Claude Code wartet auf Input" with title "Claude Code"' 2>/dev/null || true
